ENCHANTMENT_STEALTH

Stealth is an Enchantment that grants a 10-60% chance for  Timid mobs that would normally flee to remain still. It can be applied to Boots.

Ability

[edit | edit source]

Boots applied with Stealth grant a 10-60% chance for  Timid mobs that would normally flee to remain still at their respective levels.

Tier Chance
I 10%
II 20%
III 30%
IV 40%
V 50%
VI 60%

Game Message

[edit | edit source]
Condition Message
When Stealth triggers
The <mob> didn't notice your presence thanks to your Stealth enchantment!

[edit | edit source]
